result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make sure every child grows up feeling safe, loved, and valued—not merely tolerated.

That single shift would change nearly everything else: less cruelty, fewer people written off, more education and opportunity, and a culture that treats human dignity as something to protect rather than something to earn.
